member.para: The epilogue year that became a chapter number. "Corsa nello spazio" (Italian, 18 h, --chapter-phrase none, build 251, 2026-08-06) heads its epilogue "Epilogo / 2179 / Spazio profondo", and 2179 is the year: spoken alone, flanked by real pauses so passed it, and read as 2179 by the mender's 15 s and 45 s re-framings and by every one of the refinement's probes. kept it too, 1..65 followed by 2179 being strictly ascending.
What the phantom gap cost. The sequence declared chapters 66 to 2178 missing, which cost some 25 minutes of a 90-minute run in Re-probe, Scan and Re-scan sweeps over audio holding nothing.
